title: Official blog knowledge stage 2
summary: This iteration promotes the curated OpenAI and Anthropic official blog knowledge layer into the generated homepage and a minimized public JSON projection. It keeps admission and audit details private while exposing reader-facing company counts, topics, source links, and compact knowledge cards.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog knowledge homepage|public official blog knowledge projection|official blog knowledge generated file" tests/unit.test.js tests/e2e/site.e2e.js
Playwright desktop/mobile screenshot inspection for the generated index page

lessons.lesson: The official blog module needs a public projection separate from the source knowledge index.
lessons.evidence: The generated `data/official-blogs.json` contains six reader-facing records and excludes admission, admission policy, source audit, self-check, candidate, and rationale fields.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future blog excerpt pages and daily cross-links reading from the public projection unless an internal authoring task explicitly needs admission metadata.

lessons.lesson: Homepage quality gates should cover the knowledge module directly.
lessons.evidence: `evaluateIndexPageChecklist` now checks for the official blog module, OpenAI/Anthropic cards, the public JSON link, and absence of internal admission/audit text.
lessons.recommended_action: Add later graph/cross-link requirements to the same deterministic index checklist before expanding the public surface.

lessons.lesson: First-pass blog admission should use the title plus opening preview rather than full manual reading.
lessons.evidence: The admission policy now treats new products, new models, technical practices, harness engineering, agent workflows, evals, and implementation write-ups as includable, while ordinary partnerships, customer-adoption news, market updates, events, hiring, funding, and sales copy are excluded unless reusable implementation detail is hinted and needs review.
lessons.recommended_action: Use this first-pass rule when adding automated OpenAI/Anthropic blog feed ingestion.

suggestions.issue: The homepage had no visible entrypoint for curated official blog knowledge even after Stage 1 created the data layer.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 2 adds `#official-blog-knowledge`, `docs/data/official-blogs.json`, generated-file planning, publish keep-list coverage, unit tests, e2e checks, and desktop/mobile screenshot inspection.
suggestions.suggestion: Expose the official blog knowledge base as a compact homepage module backed by a sanitized public JSON projection.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Daily reports and future blog excerpt pages can link to a stable, reader-facing knowledge surface without exposing internal triage metadata.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through generated homepage rendering, public data projection, publish planning, deterministic checklist coverage, e2e browser checks, and full validation.
validation_evidence: official blog knowledge homepage renders curated blog graph entrypoint
public official blog knowledge projection is generated and planned

followups.action: Stage 3 should connect daily report items to official blog knowledge records through related blog ids and related report dates.
Add automated OpenAI/Anthropic blog feed ingestion with first-pass title/opening-preview triage and needs-review output for technical customer stories.
